reviewFindings.meaning: Canonical object joins require trusted same-tenant identity scope. Global uniqueness, principal identity, and cross-tenant deduplication are not inferred.
Immutable version identities and typed exact-version lineage are distinct from content digests, aggregate versions, job attempts, and legacy transcript UUIDs. Durable enforcement remains unadmitted.

All 13 current relationship records resolve to catalogued endpoints and typed identity contracts. Preserve the historical 11-record snapshot; current count 13 is source reconciled under PXD-140. No storage or runtime parity is claimed.

PDP-0 defines five distinct product clock domains: source video presentation, audio sample, story/explanation, simulation execution, and wall-clock time. Decode DTS remains ordering metadata, not a sixth product clock. PDP-1 defines rational value and conversion semantics while legacy scalar/wire bindings, clock alignment, scientific calibration, and runtime adapter qualification remain unknown or not evaluated. Spatial frames require registered explicit source/target versions, units, signed axes, and handedness consistent with basis parity; declaration validation does not apply a transform. Provider confidence/similarity comparisons require exact provider/metric/method/version/unit scope and establish no calibration.

Current Java, TypeScript, OpenAPI, protobuf, SQL, lifecycle, and package shapes are observations/preservation constraints. Exact adapters, producer/consumer parity, external package publication, and consumer acceptance are not established.

Each of the 21 proposal-scope objects now has an explicit tenant/version/reference/lifecycle/unknown definition. Existing per-object scopeStatus values remain unchanged; policy authority, scientific qualification, and runtime/materialization boundaries remain explicit.

Both records are applicable to P1-01 identity and typed-reference reconciliation. ConsentReference names an authority-issued revision bound to tenant, principal, purpose, region, and validity; PDP-0 remains the authority for permission/currentness. GenerationControlBundle is versioned generation intent only and cannot assert model or identity truth. Their proposal scopeStatus values, runtime/storage admission, and independent review are unchanged.

valueReview.rule: Stable opaque reference with no embedded authority; type/scope/version comes from the referring contract. Unknown or untrusted tenant scope cannot join canonical records.
Digest is integrity evidence bound to named algorithm and canonical bytes, not artifact/version identity; declared-but-unverified digest is untrusted.
Nonnegative integer count of bytes; fractional, negative, overflowed, or unit-ambiguous input is invalid. Wire-specific integer limits remain adapter-bound.
Absolute lifecycle/deadline instant on wall clock, distinct from media, simulation, story, sample, and frame coordinates. Conversion requires explicit source precision and must report lost precision.
Nonnegative interval bound to an identified clock and unit. Explicit `durationMs` is milliseconds; an unqualified duration does not inherit that unit and cannot be silently converted.
Exact position on a named source stream timebase with explicit clock/stream identity. Missing PTS, timebase, or alignment is UNKNOWN and not synthesized from wall-clock or duration.

Integer sample boundary/index tied to an exact stream, sample rate, and sample count; boundary range is [0,sampleCount], addressable samples [0,sampleCount). Priming/padding adjustment requires separate explicit mapping.

Exact cadence is rational frames per second (or reciprocal rational frame timebase); variable-rate video requires per-frame source timestamps. Scalar fps is not promoted to rational or constant cadence without a source contract.

Image coordinate binds exact image version, dimensions, origin, axes, and pixel-center or pixel-boundary convention. Crop/rotation/world-frame changes require explicit image mapping; incompatible conventions reject conversion.

Quantity carries exact magnitude, dimension, and explicit unit. Only listed SI length/time conversions are defined; missing units, dimension mismatch, unlisted units, or unsupported scientific calibration remain unresolved and cannot default.
Uncertainty is scoped to named estimate/metric/method/version and units; confidence is not correctness, absence is not pass, and unknown is not zero.
Sensitivity classification propagates the strongest source floor to derivatives. Unknown or unmapped vocabulary preserves source value and blocks a lower classification claim.
A disposition is a separate result for a named policy axis and exact subject/purpose/region/version scope. This catalog does not enumerate outcomes or substitute one axis for another.
